'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Solomon Islands unrest]]
**[[Australian Federal Police]] take control of the [[Solomon Islands]] capital of [[Honiara]] following three days of civil unrest. A nighttime curfew begins at 7:00 p.m. local time while [[riot|rioting]] and [[looting]] continues in the [[Chinatown, Honiara|Chinatown]] suburb of the city. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/solomon-islands-pm-blames-foreign-powers-unrest-protests-spread-2021-11-26/ (Reuters)]
**Three people are found dead at a burnt-out store in the Chinatown suburb in Honiara. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/27/three-bodies-found-after-days-of-unrest-in-solomon-island (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Stock|Stocks]] and [[Price of oil|oil prices]] decline sharply amid growing concerns over the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/8df04124-c8e7-4c30-b4da-082ea635f308 (FT)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/11/26/european-stocks-concerns-over-a-new-covid-variant.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Mexico bus crash]]
**A passenger bus crashes on a highway in [[San José del Rincón]], [[Mexico]], killing 19 people and injuring 32 others. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/19-dead-20-injured-mexico-pilgrimage-bus-crash-81409409 (ABC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]]
****[[Belgium]] reports its first case of the [[Omicron variant]] in an unvaccinated person who travelled abroad. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/belgium-seeks-slow-down-social-life-fight-fourth-covid-wave-2021-11-26/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Czech Republic]] reports a record 27,717 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/czech-infections-hit-new-record-high-president-going-home/2021/11/26/1d4bfc90-4eb9-11ec-a7b8-9ed28bf23929_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] imposes [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mandatory mask wearing]] in all indoor venues and outdoor [[Christmas market]]s, even when a Health Pass is required for an event, due to an increase in COVID-19 cases, hospitalizations, and deaths. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/11/25/france-pushes-booster-vaccines-and-makes-masks-mandatory (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 76,414 new cases of COVID-19. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/germany-sees-record-covid-19-cases-for-3rd-day-in-a-row/2431378 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Hong Kong]] reports its first two cases of the Omicron variant in a man who had travelled from South Africa this month, and later in another man staying across the hall in the same [[quarantine]] hotel. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/11/26/world/asia/south-africa-covid-variant-hong-kong.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] reports its first case of the Omicron variant in a person who travelled from [[Malawi]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-detects-first-case-of-new-highly-mutated-covid-19-strain/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]], [[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****The [[Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases]] approves the entry of fully-vaccinated foreign nationals from green-list countries beginning on December 1. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1520195/fully-vaxxed-foreigners-from-green-countries-can-enter-ph-starting-dec-1 (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
**[[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]
***The [[World Health Organization]] names the Lineage B.1.1.529 variant as "Omicron" and designates it as a "variant of concern" due to the variant's large number of mutations and an increased risk of reinfection. [https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/public-global-health/583203-who-calls-new-strain-omicron-variant-of-concern (''The Hill'')]
***[[Canada]], the [[European Union|EU]], [[Israel]], [[Japan]], [[Morocco]], the [[Philippines]], [[Singapore]], [[Turkey]], the [[UAE]], the [[UK]], and the [[U.S.]] ban flights from [[South Africa]], [[Namibia]], [[Zimbabwe]], [[Botswana]], [[Lesotho]], [[Mozambique]], [[Malawi]], and [[Eswatini]] due to the Omicron variant. [https://edition.cnn.com/travel/article/new-covid-variant-travel/index.html (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
**[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelensky]] accuses [[Russia]] of plotting a [[Coup d'état|coup]] against him and says that [[Ukrainian oligarchs|Ukrainian tycoon]] [[Rinat Akhmetov]] was being enlisted to help plan the coup. Zelensky says that his country "is prepared for any scenario" as tensions rise. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/ukraine-zelensky-russia-coup/2021/11/26/16e51c80-4e0d-11ec-a7b8-9ed28bf23929_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2021 Belarus–European Union border crisis]]
**[[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] makes a public appearance at the [[Belarus–Poland border]] for the first time since the [[migrant crisis]] began. Lukashenko gives a speech to migrants, telling them that they are free to either return home or head [[European Union|west]], saying, "If you want to go westwards, we won't detain you, choke you, beat you. It's up to you. Go through. Go."  [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/lukashenko-tells-migrants-belarus-poland-border-he-wont-make-them-go-home-2021-11-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[France–Italy relations]]
**[[Italian Prime Minister]] [[Mario Draghi]] and [[French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] sign a treaty that strengthens the ties between the two countries "in areas including defence, migration, the economy, culture and trade". [https://www.euractiv.com/section/global-europe/news/italy-france-sign-quirinale-treaty-as-merkels-exit-tests-european-diplomacy/ (Euractiv)] [https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2021/11/26/macron-a-roma-oggi-la-firma-del-trattato-del-quirinale_9ad0ca23-9e33-40ee-8e77-cbd249c85aa1.html (ANSA)]

*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**Three people are killed and four others injured during a [[mass shooting]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]], United States. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna6833 (NBC News)]
